newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU signs conventions on fraud, Europol personnel.
newsitem.headline: EU signs conventions on fraud, Europol personnel.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday signed conventions aimed at clamping down on fraud by criminal organisations within the European Union and giving Europol staff the same immunity enjoyed by workers for international organisations.

Signed in Brussels by EU ambassadors, the second protocol to the convention on the protection of the EU's financial interests provides for sanctions against criminal organisations having defrauded the EU.
Under the convention the booty can be confiscated and member states are expected to take necessary measures to penalise for laundering of the defrauded funds.
Under the convention laying down immunity for Europol personnel throughout they EU they will enjoy the immunity necessary for them to do their work.
The two conventions now have to be ratified by the 15 EU members.
